tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mgon po rtag pa'i rdo rje tshe dbang 'chi med sgrub pa'i 'dod 'jo bzhugs so//

"$ 'jigs byed he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs dang drag po yid srubs nor lha'i bus// rgyal bar ma nus 'chi bdag gtum po'i g.yul// rmig med 'joms mdzad dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal// bla ma'i zhabs dang gnyis min der phyag 'tshal// rgyud don bla ma'i zhal las 'ongs gang 'dir// 'jigs byed he ru ka yi lung thob pas// rtog bzo dri ma'i rnyog pas ma spags par// padma dkar pos gzhan la sbyin par bya// dpal 'jigs byed he ru ka zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa la brten nas 'chi ba med pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar rang dang gzhan 'jug par mos pa dag gis rgyud nas mngon par bsngags pa'i gnas su stegs bu gtsang mar maṇḍal padma 'dab ma brgyad pa mdzes tshon du byas pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir lha'i mtshan ma bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi mandzi'i khar rin po che'i bum pa 'bras bu can gyi shing ngam ku shas kha brgyan/ dri ma med pa'i dar gyis mgul dkris pa bzhagagayas su tshe'i 'brang rgyas dang g.yon du tshe chang bdud rtsi lnga btab pas ka pā la bkang ba bzhagaslob dpon gyi srin lag gi khrag gtar ba'i nya skyogs bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa dam tshig gi rdzas dang*/ tshogs dang mchod pa ma tshang ba med pa phyag len bzhin bshams te bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis mgon dkar phyag bzhi par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od kyis bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas mgon dkar phyag bzhi pa'i lha tshogs bla ma dang gnyis su med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥn maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ oṃ shri he ru ka sa pa ri wā re arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dyā/ shapta pra tītstsha hūm̐ gis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyi bdun rnam dag byas/ tshogs zhing rang la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags

badzra muḥ yis bsdu'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ba la dgod par bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya'o/ snyam pa'i bsam pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shu ddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i dbyings su chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du baṃ ro pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la hūm̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad gyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bsal/ 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rtag pa'i rdo rje zla ba chu shel gyi mdog ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig spyan gsum khro la 'dzum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos 'chi med kyi mdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che baiḍūrya dkar po'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin cing gnyis pas ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon dang pos thod khrag thugs ka'i 'og tu bsnams shing gnyis pas kha ṭwaṃ ga rtse gsum 'gying stabs su 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa brgya'i phyed kyi do shal can/ zhing lpags dang glang po che'i ko rlon gyis stod g.yogs shing stag gi pags pas sham thabs byas pa/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus spras pa/ sku'i yum zhi byed ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpa' po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis me'i klong chen po'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i shar du 'gugs byed mthing kha thugs kyi yum/ lhor bya rog sngon mo yon tan gyi yum/ nub tu srung byed dmar mo gsung gi yum/ byang du sgrol byed ljang khu 'phrin las kyi yum/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum pa/

phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan cing phyogs kyi gos can/ zhabs brkyang bskum gar stabs su bzhugs pa/ mtshams bzhir byang sems dkar dmar gyis gtams pa'i bum pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pas mtshan pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas pa'i srog hūm̐ dkar po/ de'i mthar gdags pa'i srog oṃ badzra kā wu wa wa pa shā ya mahā kā la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a mā raṇi dzi nas bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dam tshig pa dang gnyis med du bsres/ dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ ral pa ser po gyen du brdzes pa'i dbus su mi bskyod pas brgyan cing*/ yum la rnam snang*/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas/ byang gi yum la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka 'i sngags gyis chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod// bdud rtsi swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ mdun du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ badzra a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi sa myang bar bya'o// bdag gi rnal 'byor ro// mdun gyi dkyil 'khor swa bhā wa sa sbyangs chos thams cad nas/ de las 'od zer 'phros bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa ma dzaḥ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ye shes mgon po khyod// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol// gsang ba'i yum lnga gshegs su gsol// khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba// nag po ro langs dur khrod bdag

/mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur spyon// bsil ba'i tshal du mtshan gsol ba// nag po mna' gzan kun gyi gshed// mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur spyon// sgrub pa po yi gnas mchog na// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i tshogs ni si li li// sha chen spos kyi dud sprin khyil li li// bhandha rus pa'i tshogs ni khra la la/ a kar dud sogs spos ngad thul lu lu// mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs so da tshur spyon/ zhes mngon sum du byon par bsams nas/ shrī badzra he ru ka arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du bsres/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i sprin mtha' klas pa'i mchod rdzas spro bas mchod par mos te/ hūm̐ rab 'byams sangs rgyas zhing khams kun khyab pa'i// me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo yid 'ong spro ba'i sprin// mgon po 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// rab mdzes blta bas mi ngoms gzhon nu ma// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i rdo rje ni// sgeg mo'i rnam thar 'dzin pas mkha' khyab pa// mgon po zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gang*// sgron ma lnga yi rnam par rol pa'i rdzas// rgya mtsho'i klong ltar mi zad 'khyil ba 'di// mgon po= zhes mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ mdun bskyed do// bum pa/ tshe zan/ tshe chang rnams swa bhā was sbyangs/ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa dang ka pā la mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa 'i nas bstod pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin bya'o// de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'phreng ba las 'od zer 'phros/ tshe la gnod byed kyi bgegs thams cad bsgral/

lha ma srin sde brgyad thams cad dbang du bsdus/ de rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshe bsring bar nus pa'i snod bcud thams cad bkug bum pa dang ka pā la'i lha tshogs rnams dang gnyis su med par bstim par bsam zhing yi ge bcu bdun pa ci rigs pa bzlas/ brgya rtsa brgyad srin lag gtar ba'i khrag la gdab bo// de'i mthar/ hūm̐/ zhi byed dkar mo sku yi yum// zhes sogs dbang gi cho gar bshad pa bzhin gyis bskul/ dmigs pa de nyid dang*/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzi zhes pa dang bcu bdun pa'i kā la ya'i mthar ā yuḥbhrūṃ ā yuḥdzaḥdzaḥ btags la khri phrag gcig bzla bar bya'o/ /mthar bum pa dang tshe chang gi ka pā la'i lha tshogs 'od du zhu bas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma swa bhā was sbyangs/ mdun du yaṃ las sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ yi ge bcu bdun pa'i mthar pa ri wā re i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis phul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ mthar mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o// rang gzhan gnyis ka 'jug pa tshe dbang gi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ de la bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ tshe sbyin pa dang*/ shis pa brjod pa gsum las/ dang po la/ khrus byas/ maṇḍal phul te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes sogs gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla ma mgon dkar phyag bzhi par gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs kyis sdom pa blang*/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad gsal bar dmigs/ khyad par bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la mi phyed pa'i gdung bas/ sangs rgyas kun dngos slob dpon dang*// 'jig byed che la bdag skyabs kyi// gtum chen khros pa 'chi bdag gi /bdud sde'i g.yul las bdag rgyal mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang gi snying rtse mo gyen la gyur te dkar nag gi mtshams su yi ge maṃ nag po de las 'od zer nag po 'phros/

lus phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsdus/ yi ge maṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'chi bdag bdud po 'jigs su rung ba/ kha gdangs pa/ mig bgrad pa/ spar ba gdengs pa/ rid cing skem pa zhig tu gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i yum gyi mkha' rdo rje'i lam nas hūm̐ mthing nag spros/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi nus mthu bsdus/ hūm̐ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yab yum gyi gsang ba'i bu bya rog gi gdong pa can spyan gsum me'i phung po ltar dmar ba khros shing rkan sgra dang bcas pa'i zhal brdabs pas srid gsum g.yo ba/ sku mdog mthing nag thung la gel ba'i gzugs can phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag dkur brten pa/ lte ba man chad gnam lcags kyi phur pa mgar gyi sol me lta bur dmar ba/ dbal gsum dang ldan pa'i rtse mo shin tu rno ba gang la reg pa thams cad thal bar rlog pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa phyir 'thon/ rang gi spyi bo brgyud nas 'chi bdag bdud kyi spyi bor phab pas bdud pos ma bzod par bshang lam na mar bros/ de kho na ltar ded/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thug de yang phug chu'i dkyil 'khor na mar bros pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor la thug ste rnam par 'thor ba'i rlung gis bdud po'i lus rdul phra rab tu gtor nas mi dmigs par byas te las kyi mgon po de nyid rang 'dra bcur song nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams bcur 'khod/ bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bsrung bar mos te/ oṃ karma mahā kā la kā ka mu kha badzra kī lā ya rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ bgegs sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa tshe sbyin pa la/ tshe 'gug pa/ tshe bstim pa/ tshe sba ba rnam pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla mas gu gul dang sha chen sbyar ba'i spos/ rol mo dbyangs snyan pos 'then zhing mda' rgod sgro la dar tshon sna lnga btags pas g.yab cing*/

hūm̐ dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma// zhi byed dkar mo sku yi yum// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskul la/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas// tshe dbang ma lus 'dir khug cig /shar gyi= 'gugs byed mthing kha thugs kyi yum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskul la// steng= tshe dbang= lho yi phyogs= bya rog sngon mo yon tan yum// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskul la/ steng= tshe= nub kyi= srung byed dmar mo gsung gi yum// padma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskul la/ steng= tshe dbang= byang= sgrol byed ljang khu las kyi yum// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskul la// steng= tshe dbang= badzra ā yurdzñā na aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥzhes bskul bas yum lnga'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sprul pas rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskul bas nam mkha'i khams mthas klas pa na gnas pa'i tshe bsring bar nus pa'i gzungs/ dpal bskyed par nus pa'i dbang thang thams cad lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus mnyes par byas te/ bum pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro mnyam du gyur par bsams la/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag rgyas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa tshe bstim pa ni/ swa bhā was slob ma sbyangs te/ chu skyes kyi lte ba nas/ me'i klong chen po'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis mgon po'i skur bskyed/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum lngas rin po che'i bum pa thogs pas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i mos pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi// rdo rje'i dbang bskur 'di sbyin pas// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob gyur cig /oṃ badzra kā wu wa wa pa shā ya kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa ā yu rdzñā na bhrūṃ/ zhes bum pa'i bdud rtsis spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing tshangs bug nas blugs pas lus kyi nang thams cad 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas rtsa'i mdud pa thams cad dbral dbu mar dag pas lus 'chi med du grub/

rlung phyi rol du 'pho ba 'gags/ nyi zla'i rgyu ba thams cad dbu mar tshud pas ngag 'chi med du grub/ khams dkar dmar gyi thig le 'dzag med du 'chings pas lus thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas gang bas yid 'chi med du grub par bsam la tshe'i ril bu sbyin tshe chang blud do// gsum pa tshe sba ba ni/ tshe'i 'brang rgyas spyi bor bzhag ste/ dpal ldan mgon po yab yum dang*// gsang ba'i yum bzhir bcas pa la// skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di yi// tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms// zhes brjod pas gtor ma'i pad 'dab thod pa bum pa yum bzhi la thim/ de gtso bo yab yum la/ ye shes pa yum skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du tsitta rin po che'i gur khang du byon/ yab zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang yum nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med par gyur ba steng 'og tu kha sbyar ba'i dbus su 'chi ba med pa tshe'i gzungs hūm̐ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa spu shad kyis bris pa lta bur gyur pa'i mtha' mar gdags pa'i srog yi ge bcu bdun pa bar med du 'khor ba srin lag gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i snying rtsa'i nang du hūm̐ mthing nag re bsams

la/ yang dag par bsngags pa'i srin lag g.yon pa'i khrag gis gnas gsum srin lag gnyis kyi rtsa ba nas thig le bris la/ srog sngags kyi mthar rakṣa rakṣa btags pas bsrung bar bya'o// de nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe yi lha// yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa la// skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di yi// tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms// de bzhin shar rdo rje'i phyag rgya/ lhor rin po che/ nub padma/ byang rgya gram= tshe'i zan yang sbyin no// gsum pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad lag tu gtad de/ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// de ring khyod kyi 'chi bdag bdud bcom pas// lha mo brgyad kyi bkra shis gang lags pa'i// bkra shis dam pas shis pa brjod par bgyi// zhes slob ma rnams kyi dpral bar li khri'i g.yung drung ris sam tshom bu bkod/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad mdun du bdar/ tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig ces sogs dang*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// lo brgya thub cing dang*/ padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan/ zhes dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan bsrung phyir// zhes dang*/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs kyi shis pa brjod tshogs la gzhung bzhin rol/ rjes chog ni/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha bdag nyid la bstim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'chi ba med pa'i tshe 'grub nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus par// de yi sa la 'god par shog/ ces bsngo ba bya'o// bsgrub pa'i tshe/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yab yum gyis dngos su tshe'i mchog ster ba dang*/ gtor ma sngar bas bkrag che zhing bdud rtsi'i ror 'gyur/ tshe chang dang bum pa khol zhing lud pa dang*/ tshe'i ril bu mang du 'phel bar 'gyur ro// ngag dbang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gcig gyur pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po'i byin rlabs thob de yis// zab rgyas chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed pa la// pad dkar blo ni nam yang thogs pa min// zhes dpal ye shes mgon po'i tshe dbang gi cho ga

bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i he ru ka nyid kyis byin rlabs kyi 'pho ba thob pa'i/ rig pa 'dzin pa padma dkar pos bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag bzhin du lho brag mkhar chur sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bīrya bha dra'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
